title: Zabaa'n par mad'ha hai baaghe Ali ke nounehaalo ki
body:
Zabaa'n par mad'ha hai baaghe Ali ke nounehaalo ki
Gulistaa's se nahi kam majlise naazuk qayaalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
jagah jab mol li sheh ne to haatif ne kaha ro kar
yahi'n basti basegi faatema ke nounehaalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab aata zikr beto ka to zainab roke kehti thi
khuda baqshe abhi kya umr thi un marne waalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Dare qaima pe zainab peet kar sar ko ye kehti thi
Are logo qabar aayi na ran se mere laalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar kas kar Ali akber ne jab shamla rakha sar par
balaae'n uth ke leli maa ne ghoongar waale baalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Gire jab shaah ghode se nida haatif ki ye aayi
zamee'n jhaadi hui hai fatima zahra ke baalo ki
<<DIVIDER>>
jawaanaane hussaini ne safe'n ulti pare tode
na bhoolegi ladaai ta qayaamat marne waalo ki
